record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Song<WH07892> of degrees<WH04609>.<Fo><Fo> Many a time<WH07227> have they afflicted<WH06887><WTH8804> me from my youth<WH05271>, may Israel<WH03478> now say<WH0559><WTH8799>: <RF>Many...: or, Much<Rf>
